S6:14.text: Abram had heard, to wit, that his brother Lot was taken, he num-bred of the ſeruants borne in his houſe, wel appointed, three hundred and eighteen: and purſued them vnto Dan

S6:16.text: And he brought backe al the ſubſtance, and Lot his brother with his ſubſtance, the women alſo and the people.

S6:17.text: And the King of Sodom went forth to meet them, after he returned from the ſlaughter of Chodorlahomor, and of the Kings that were with him in the vale Sauce, which is the Kings vale.

S6:18.text: But Melchiſedech the King of Salem, bringing forth bread and wine, for he was the Prieſt of God moſt High, 19."

S6:19.text: 19.bleſſed him, and ſaid: Bleſſed be Abram to God the Higheſt, which created heauen and earth

S6:20.text: and bleſſed be God the Higheſt by whoſe protection the enemyes are in thy hands. And he gaue him the tyths of al.

S6:21.text: And the King of Sodom ſaid to Abram: Giue me the ſoules, and the reſt take to thee.

S9:10.text: But the Woodland vale had many pitts of bitume. Therfore the king of Sodome, and of Gomorra turned their backes, and were ouerthrowne there: and they that remained fled to the mountaine.
